findings.explanation: After a transient connection failure, the only phone can be skipped indefinitely. If the scanner reports it once in the first three seconds of each scan, `again` is discarded when the callback returns. Each deadline restarts the same scan without attempting GATT again. A Node probe reproduced five retries with no further connection attempt. Retain the skipped candidate for the scan and try it after the preference window or at the deadline if no fresh peer is found.

An advertisement from an address excluded by the pin increments `matched` and prevents variant rotation. If the current variant reports only that advertiser, the watch never tries a variant that can discover the pinned phone. A Node probe reproduced six consecutive scans on the same variant. Base rotation on whether the scan found a candidate that passed the pin check.

A fallback variant inherits the deadline of the variant that failed. A Node probe delivered a failure at 7.9 seconds and confirmed that the fallback received only 100 ms before being marked exhausted. Rearm the scanner-scoped deadline for each launched variant and reset its match counters.

An age-stale heartbeat can still cut off the loss pulse. The render timer starts the pulse when effective age crosses 10 seconds, then an accepted heartbeat with `a > 10000` returns `cancel: true` and `applyVibe()` stops it. A Node probe using the actual page script reproduced the cancellation. Route cancellation from a still-stale frame through `cancelTurn()` so the loss pulse can finish.

The replacement path starts the next pattern even if `stop(id)` returns false. If the old task is still active, the new start can return 205, fall back to one pulse, and leave the old task uncancellable because its ID was discarded. A Node mock reproduced this sequence. Handle the stop result in both cancellation paths and retain the old task ID and queued replacement until the task clears. [Xiaomi Vela vibrator API](https://iot.mi.com/vela/quickapp/zh/features/system/vibrator.html)

A terminal GATT failure is validated before it is posted to the service handler, but the posted message carries only a reason. If an old failure is posted while `STATE_ON` is starting a replacement, it can run afterward and schedule `startBle()` against the healthy server, tearing it down and disconnecting the watch. This follows from the callback ordering in source. Carry the BLE attempt generation through the post and ignore superseded failures and retries.

Skipping a leading separator can put a road name back into the maneuver input. With `100 m` and `On Left Fork Road toward downtown`, the split selects `toward`, then the standalone `left` rule emits a left turn and can trigger vibration. Treat the leading road phrase as context and classify a separate, explicit maneuver clause if one follows.

Roundabout exit extraction still reads the destination text. For `At the roundabout, take the second exit onto Exit 7 Ramp`, the numeric rule matches `Exit 7` in the road name before the ordinal rule gets to `second exit`, so the watch displays exit 7. Extract the exit number from the maneuver portion, including the explicit leading roundabout construction.

A malformed 0x06 or 0x07 field with a 17-byte payload is accepted when its first 16 bytes match the HUD UUID. A Node probe confirmed the acceptance. Check that `(len - 1) % 16 === 0` before scanning the field for a match. [Bluetooth Core Specification Supplement](https://www.bluetooth.com/wp-content/uploads/Files/Specification/HTML/CSS_v14/out/en/core-supplementary-features/data-types-specification.html)

If every `startBLEScan()` call throws synchronously, the retry path closes the scanner, then the outer launch code publishes a scanning status and installs a watchdog for the closed scanner. A Node probe reproduced the incorrect status throughout the backoff. Return from each post-launch path when its scanner is no longer active.

A malformed signed distance such as `-1  030 m` can still become a valid-looking 30 m and trigger an urgent warning. The regex can start at `030` because the boundary check only covers one grouping space, and the sign check then stops at `1`. Reject a candidate preceded by digits across grouping whitespace so a malformed signed token cannot be parsed from its suffix.

limits: Inspected the named current source files, including new files, protocol v1.2, and the round-three review. The snapshot contained no Git metadata or baseline diff, so exact change attribution and tracked status could not be verified.

Ran focused read-only Node probes for watch behavior with mocked native APIs. Phone findings are from source inspection, with a translated regex probe for the parser boundaries. The full build, lint, and test results were supplied by the controller.

The latest changes were unverified on hardware. S5 scan reporting cadence, vibration stop failures, OPPO Bluetooth-toggle timing, real Maps notification formats, wrist-down behavior, and long rides remain unverified.
The shared default pairing token was the controller's accepted exception.
